prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Summary of key commitments in the Liberal Democrats Manifesto 2024 (policy-focused)

Economy and business
- Industrial strategy focused on green infrastructure, innovation and skills; fix UK–EU trade barriers.
- Emergency Home Energy Upgrades to cut bills; National Food Strategy; careful fiscal rules.
- Tax changes: reverse bank tax cuts; increase Digital Services Tax to 6%; fair CGT reform; 4% levy on FTSE-100 share buybacks.
- Expand British Business Bank; financial inclusion strategy; universal digital literacy target.
- Abolish business rates, replace with a Commercial Landowner Levy; late payment enforcement.
- AI: cross-sector regulatory framework, transparency for public sector AI, global standards.
- Workforce: replace apprenticeship levy with flexible skills levy; Lifelong Skills Grants; Worker Protection Enforcement Authority; modernise gig-economy rights; overhaul sick pay; enhanced parental leave as day-one rights.

Climate, energy and environment
- Net zero by 2045; 90% of electricity from renewables by 2030; rooftop solar incentives.
- Free insulation and heat pumps for low-income households; zero‑carbon standards for new buildings.
- Social energy tariff; decouple electricity prices from gas; maintain fracking ban; no new coal.
- Expand storage (hydrogen, batteries, pumped); community energy reforms.
- End sewage discharges: tougher regulator, penalties, public benefit company model; binding nature targets and 60m trees/year; Clean Air Act; deposit return scheme; curb single-use plastics; restore peatlands and blue carbon habitats.

Health and care
- Right to see a GP within 7 days/24 hours urgent; recruit 8,000 GPs; expand pharmacy roles and 24/7 booking.
- NHS dentistry access guarantee; targeted free check-ups; supervised toothbrushing in schools.
- Mental health hubs for young people; school-based professionals; expand talking therapies; modernise Mental Health Act.
- Cancer: treatment start within 62 days; more radiotherapy kit; cancer nurses; screening and research.
- Workforce retention plan; independent pay review; hospital estate renewal; interoperable NHS IT; faster access to medicines via EU cooperation.
- Drugs policy: public health approach; expand addiction services; legal, regulated cannabis market for adults.
- Social care: free personal care; workforce plan, Royal College of Care Workers, Carer’s Minimum Wage (+£2/hour); unpaid carers’ leave and respite; National Care Agency and portable care packages.

Education and families
- Mental health professional in every school; real-terms per‑pupil funding increases; clear repair backlog.
- Tutoring Guarantee for disadvantaged pupils; early years: extra hours and higher pupil premium.
- Reinstate maintenance grants; Lifelong Skills Grants; teacher workforce strategy; curriculum and Ofsted reform; SEND funding and national body.
- Extend free school meals to all children in poverty; overhaul parental leave/pay (higher rates, extra month for partners, day-one rights incl. self‑employed); Erasmus+ return; paid neonatal leave.

Housing and communities
- Build 380,000 homes/year incl. 150,000 social; 10 garden cities; brownfield first; “use‑it‑or‑lose‑it” permissions.
- Abolish leasehold; cap ground rents; ban no‑fault evictions; default three‑year tenancies; landlord register.
- Councils empowered to end Right to Buy and control second homes/short lets; end rough sleeping; rent‑to‑own for social housing; remove dangerous cladding at no cost to leaseholders.
- Multi‑year council settlements; gigabit broadband nationwide; rural services and buses support.

Transport
- Accelerate EV charging, restore plug‑in grant, 2030 zero‑emission sales requirement; cut VAT on public charging to 5%.
- Freeze rail fares; new Railway Agency; electrification, Northern Powerhouse Rail; accessible stations.
- Bus franchising powers, integrated funding, extend £2 fare cap; national active travel strategy; more road maintenance.
- Aviation: fairer taxes, private jet super tax, emissions disclosure; ban short domestic flights with <2.5h rail alternative (unless alternative-fuelled).

Rights, policing and justice
- Community policing; guarantee police attendance at burglaries; Online Crime Agency; tackle court backlogs.
- End disproportionate stop and search; stronger VAWG support; youth diversion; anti‑fraud measures.
- Uphold Human Rights Act/ECHR; hate crime measures incl. misogyny; ban conversion practices; Digital Bill of Rights; expanded refuges and rape crisis centres; disability employment support; assisted dying free vote.

Immigration and asylum
- End Hostile Environment; move work/student visa policy to relevant departments; scrap Illegal Migration Act and Rwanda plan.
- Three‑month service standard for asylum decisions; allow work after three months; expand safe/legal routes; humanitarian travel permits; limit detention; 60‑day move‑on for refugees.
- Flexible work visa system; exemptions for NHS/care; expand Youth Mobility; reverse higher family visa thresholds; protect EU citizens’ status and proof; implement Windrush reforms.

Political reform and devolution
- Proportional representation (STV) for MPs and English councils; votes at 16; ministerial code in law; Lords reform; donation caps; citizens’ assemblies; transparency in lobbying and communications.
- Federal approach to the UK; enhanced devolved powers; constitutional convention.

Defence and international
- Increase defence spending towards 2.5% of GDP; reverse Army cuts; maintain nuclear deterrent; tighter arms export controls; procurement reform; support personnel and veterans.
- Restore 0.7% ODA and independent department; support Ukraine incl. using seized Russian assets; rebuild EU relations via staged roadmap towards deeper market access; fund BBC World Service; support ceasefire and two‑state process in Israel–Palestine; targeted human rights sanctions.
